name: Production office space
description: This dataset lists production office spaces, likely film and television production facilities, with 25 sampled records and 17 fields. Each row identifies a studio by name and includes contact details such as phone, fax, website, and email, along with a full street address, ZIP code, and borough. Geographic identifiers include latitude and longitude, community board, community council, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), and the city planning identifiers BIN and BBL. The data supports locating production offices by neighborhood, mapping facilities, and contacting studios directly, making it useful for location scouting, urban planning analysis, and directory-style reference.
